title: MC 923: Ceramic Kilns
officialText:
923.1 General.

Kilns shall be listed and labeled unless otherwise approved in accordance with Section 105.1 Electric kilns shall comply with UL 499. The approval of unlisted appliances in accordance with Section 105.1 shall be based on approved engineering evaluation.

923.1.1 Installation.

Kilns shall be installed in accordance with the manufacturer's instructions and the provisions of this code.
